occurrences.key: Concrete boundary checks beyond changed context: inspected the acceptance delegation at :168–173 for reachability and recursion; inspected collection inventory production and the unchanged validation at :283–293 for malformed/missing/duplicate records. Malformed records retain an error even alongside valid records; incomplete/missing inventories for ordinary non-null complete reviews fail validation; latest records intentionally supersede earlier intent/completion snapshots. Every duplicate file entry in a selected inventory is checked, so a conflicting hash cannot silently become a pass. Existing no-work null-review semantics are preserved. Source-bound root acceptance, finding projection, settlement validation and evidence matching are unchanged. The patch does not introduce another weaker acceptance path. Final-component symlinks are rejected by lstat.isFile; ancestor symlink containment remains the independently owned .27 scope and is not reopened.
